items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: he actually introduced Artie Shaw to Buddy Rich, whom he heard playing in a club with I think it might be Bobby Hackett or Adrian Rollini or someone like that.

ctx.x: Well I want to go back with you because I read that you came from a musical family and your uncles were in the business. Were you fascinated early on by — how much did you witness of what they did and was it something that seemed like oh yes, I want to do that.

Yeah it was very interesting. I mean my older — I mean there were four brothers and they were all band leaders and they all played different instruments. And two of them became — I would say sort of household names in England certainly but also, surprisingly, in America. My uncle Sid Phillips was our leading arranger and jazz clarinet player. He wound up playing with Louis Armstrong’s U.K. All-Stars. But he’d gone to New York for Irving Mills. He was the Ambrose band arranger which was a very popular dance band…
Wow, where do you go from there?
